collection.title: VW Beetle Cabriolet 2013 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Beetle 2013 Onwards model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
